customers.description: Stores customer personal and contact details. Use for queries about customer names, emails, countries, or customer-level aggregations.

columns.customer_id: Unique identifier for customer (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
columns.name: Customer full name (TEXT)

products.description: Stores product catalog information including pricing and category. Use for queries about product names, prices, categories, or product-level aggregations.

columns.product_id: Unique identifier for product (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
columns.name: Product name (TEXT)

orders.description: Contains purchase transactions linking customers to products. Use for queries about orders, purchases, quantities, order dates, sales totals, or monthly/yearly trends.

columns.employee_id: Foreign key to employees table — sales rep who handled the order (INTEGER)
columns.order_date: Date of purchase in YYYY-MM-DD format (TEXT)

employees.description: Stores sales employee information. Use for queries about sales reps, employee performance, who handled which orders, or department-level analysis.

columns.employee_id: Unique identifier for employee (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
columns.name: Employee full name (TEXT)
columns.department: Department name such as Sales, Support, Logistics (TEXT)
columns.hire_date: Date the employee was hired in YYYY-MM-DD format (TEXT)

categories.description: Stores product category definitions. Use for queries about product categories, category names, or grouping products by category. Always join with products and orders when computing sales, revenue, or quantity sold per category.

columns.category_id: Unique identifier for category (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
columns.category_name: Name of the product category such as Electronics, Accessories, Furniture (TEXT)
